name: send_follow_up_email
description: The standard visitor, admin, and Insight intake email bundle is already authorized at website check-in and queued by the backend when the session binds. Do not call this tool for the standard follow-up, do not offer email, and do not ask for contact details. Call only if the visitor independently volunteers a callback number and explicitly confirms that number; include callbackPhone and callbackPhoneConfirmed true. Never claim email was already sent, a callback was scheduled, or a specialist was assigned.

callbackPhone.description: Optional callback number spoken and explicitly confirmed by the visitor in this conversation. Never infer or copy it from private application data.

callbackPhoneConfirmed.description: Include only as true after the visitor explicitly confirms the callback number.
